title: Elite Dragorn Jekisia
summary: Chase Jekisia through the caverns while handling her repeated reinforcements.
overview: Chase Jekisia through the caverns while handling her repeated reinforcements.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: At successive health thresholds, Jekisia relocates and calls pairs of dragorn flunkies.
Clear or control the flunkies before the group follows her to the next position.
Keep moving through the stages; the encounter has a twenty-minute reset timer.
Remaining flunkies are not automatically removed by the boss's death.
